automations.title: Automations

nobody.account_gone: Nobody was taken in: the company was deleted or excluded from the list.
nobody.no_new_person: Nobody was taken in: the list has no person at this company that the automation has not taken yet.
nobody.all_refused: Nobody was taken in: every person at this company was left out before any credit.
nobody.other: Nobody at this company was taken in.

signal.givenUp: {n, plural, one {After # failed run} other {After {n, number, credits} failed runs}} in a row, these signals count as used. The company starts a run again only when new signals reach the minimum score.
signal.givenBack: This run did not use its signals and gave them back.
signal.gone: The signals of this run are no longer available.

step.uncertain: The run stopped during this step, so what it did outside Zenbree is not known. The next run may take the same people again, but it does not charge for them, add them to the campaign or write them to HubSpot a second time.
step.notRetried: Not tried again on its own, because it may already have written.
step.leftOutInstantly: People left out of the Instantly campaign

output.notReached: Left for the next run because credits ran out
output.vendorDidNotAnswer: No answer from the email provider
output.withContact: People with an email or LinkedIn
output.refusedSince: Refused by your rules since the run

leftOut.duplicate: Already in this campaign, replied or contacted
leftOut.stopped: Stopped after a reply or an opt-out

refused.stopped: Stopped after a reply or an opt-out

skipped.previous_step_failed: Skipped because an earlier step failed.
skipped.run_ended: Skipped because the run stopped before this step.
skipped.no_new_people: Skipped because the list has no people this automation has not taken in yet.
skipped.no_people_left: Skipped because no people were left after the earlier steps.
skipped.cancelled: Skipped because the run was cancelled.
skipped.automation_paused: Skipped because the automation was paused.
skipped.reservation_expired: Skipped because the run's credit hold expired.
skipped.run_not_running: Skipped because the run had already ended.

code.vendor_failed: A data provider did not answer.
code.vendor_disabled: A data provider is turned off or not connected.
code.step_crashed: The step hit an error three times and stopped.
code.campaign_ended: The campaign has ended, so nobody can be added to it.
code.hubspot_off: HubSpot is not connected, or write-back is off.
code.hubspot_token: HubSpot did not accept the connection. Reconnect it in Integrations.
code.hubspot_failed: HubSpot refused a write. The people written before it stay written.
code.write_crashed: The HubSpot write stopped on an error. The people stay held.
code.automation_edited: The automation was edited before this run started.
code.creator_deleted: The person who made the automation deleted their account.
code.user_banned: The person who made the automation is suspended.
code.creator_left: The person who made the automation left the organization.
code.invalid_configuration: A list, campaign or HubSpot connection it uses is gone.
code.project_cap_reached: This client reached its credit limit.
code.insufficient_credits: There were not enough credits to start.
code.worker_outcome_unknown: The run stopped and did not report back. The credits its steps did not use went back.
code.credit_cap_reached: The run reached its credit cap. The people it did not reach come first in the next run.
code.other: The run hit an error that has no description yet.
code.instantly_campaign_not_found: The Instantly campaign no longer exists. Pick another one in the editor.
code.instantly_not_connected: Instantly is not connected to this client, or the saved key cannot be read. Connect it again in Integrations.
code.instantly_refused: Instantly refused the key or the account's plan. Connect it again in Integrations.
code.instantly_unreachable: Instantly did not answer, even after the retries.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.noUrl: The URL is not available. Ask an admin or Zenbree support.
webhook.secretMade: Secret made {when}. Zenbree does not show it again.
webhook.noSecret: This automation has no secret yet, so it takes no calls. Make one, then put the URL and the secret in the tool that sends the calls.
webhook.noSecretReadOnly: This automation has no secret yet, so it takes no calls. The person who made it, or an admin, can make one.
webhook.paused: The automation is paused: calls are refused until you resume it.
webhook.rotateText: The old secret stops working at once. Calls signed with it are refused from now on.
webhook.rotateUpdateSender: Put the new secret in the tool that sends the calls.
webhook.shownText: Zenbree shows it only this once. If you lose it, rotate the secret to make a new one.
webhook.pending: {n, plural, one {# call waits} other {{n, number, credits} calls wait}} to start. Each call starts its own run, one after the other.
webhook.waitingForApproval: Calls wait until you approve the review run of this version. Open it in the runs below.
webhook.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.

howTo.title: How to call it
howTo.body: Send a POST to the URL with a JSON object body of at most 16 KiB that names one person of the list: email, linkedin_url, or both. A larger body gets a 413. The person must already be in the list.
howTo.sign: Sign each call with the secret, as Standard Webhooks specifies: the headers webhook-id (a unique id for each call, so a repeat starts nothing), webhook-timestamp (in seconds, within 5 minutes of now) and webhook-signature.
howTo.answer: An answer of 202 means the call is taken. Its run starts within a minute when no other run of the automation is going.

instantlySkipped.stopped: Replied, unsubscribed or the email bounced

signal.title: Signals
signal.rule: A run starts for a company when the scores of its new signals add up to the minimum. A posting scores up to 100, halved every 30 days. Signals that arrive while the automation is paused start nothing.
signal.deletedText: This automation starts no run until you pick another watchlist in Edit.
